entrypoints.description: Storage-neutral typed reader is the semantic replay owner used by PostgreSQL, DuckDB and product-facing replay.
Storage-neutral orientation boundary exposes direct catalog membership plus deterministic grounded subject-discovery candidates without moving membership truth into presentation.
Read-only interpretation helper exposes useful source-supported or deterministic time hints without mutating canonical temporal semantics.

Deterministic read-only projection turns one already-filtered point-in-time snapshot into entries, knowledge progression and Judgment-centered storylines while keeping canonical truth separate from labelled researcher hints.

Researcher entry composes direct membership and deterministic industry-scoped grounded-memory entailment at one shared cutoff, then delegates Reality/Judgment/Outcome visibility to the typed snapshot owner.
Researcher projection reuses the same broad subject universe while keeping historical conflict/Judgment controversy separate from an explicit opt-in current research-only overlay.

extension_seams: Researcher-readable trajectory/table/graph views over an already-filtered typed snapshot.
New read-only CLI/API/UI projections that do not reimplement knowledge visibility.
Compose direct catalog membership with deterministic discoverability from already-grounded Reality/Judgment; keep the entailment provenance visible and do not promote it into membership truth.
Add deterministic, auditable role or subject entailment when premises come from existing semantic owners and the rule cannot manufacture unsupported historical timing or truth.
Add labelled researcher time/range/as-of hints that preserve source temporal precision and never overwrite canonical time.
Surface related milestones as useful signals while keeping the original target unresolved unless CAP-0004 records a direct match.
Compose explicit historical controversy with a separately labelled current research-only MODEL/JUDGMENT overlay from CAP-0006 without collapsing authority classes.
Additional storage adapters implementing the same typed reader contracts.

guards.description: Integrated replay consumes the typed DuckDB reader rather than physical tables.
Hard smoke round-trips one typed timeline across PostgreSQL and DuckDB.
Presentation regression proves a related milestone stays indeterminate/not-comparable and is never narrated as direct realization.
Researcher interpretation regression permits a useful as-of hint while preserving unknown onset in canonical Reality.
Researcher interpretation regression surfaces related milestone information value without promoting the original target to realized.
Orientation contract proves a future-known direct membership and future Outcome cannot cross the shared researcher knowledge cutoff.

Recall regression proves an Evidence-grounded industry-scoped Reality can deterministically expose a subject even when no membership row exists, while future discovery remains cutoff-filtered and no membership or role is invented by that rule.
Open-state projection regression proves the default historical lane excludes current research state while reusing the CAP-0005 subject-universe owner.
Service-capable synthetic smoke exercises PostgreSQL membership and deterministic-discovery query plumbing plus the researcher CLI without creating real industry research data.
Service-capable synthetic smoke proves the researcher CLI separates source-known historical conflict from opt-in current research-only state.
Service-capable regression exercises `longcycle research replay` at multiple historical cutoffs and verifies knowledge progression plus unchanged original Judgment content.

non_goals: Direct SQL as product replay semantics.
Creating new Fact/Judgment/Outcome or industry-membership truth records in presentation code.
Treating deterministic discoverability by itself as proof of a specific value-chain role, importance ranking or causal relation.
Silently promoting deterministic researcher hints or MODEL/JUDGMENT analysis into canonical Reality, formal membership or historical market knowledge.
Presentation code deciding its own Reality/Judgment/Outcome knowledge-cutoff eligibility.
Applying the historical knowledge cutoff to current research-only Memory/coverage state or presenting that state as contemporaneous market knowledge.
Treating current catalog canonical names as historical-name replay.
Inferring direct realization or success/failure beyond stored CAP-0004 Outcome semantics.
Rewriting an original Judgment because a later Outcome became visible.
purpose: Own storage-neutral reconstruction of what Reality, Judgment and Outcome records were knowable at a historical cutoff, plus calibrated researcher-readable projections over that filtered memory. Researcher entry uses direct source-grounded membership plus deterministic auditable entailment; presentation may add clearly labelled deterministic time/role/usefulness hints when premises support them, but never mutates canonical truth. Related milestones can be surfaced as informative without satisfying a direct target. Ambiguous role, participant importance and causality belong to the explicitly labelled CAP-0006 MODEL/JUDGMENT lane rather than being forbidden or silently promoted to Reality.
revisit_when: Only replace if a stronger storage-neutral read contract preserves no-lookahead, typed Reality/Judgment/Outcome semantics, direct-versus-entailed provenance, canonical temporal precision, explicit researcher-hint authority, membership authority outside presentation, and the historical-versus-current-research/model-analysis boundary.
title: Typed point-in-time industrial-memory replay
